At the same u and h, distinct histories produce substantially different response levels. Grouping current drive with history tests a partition not captured by the failed additive forms' separate current-drive and history contributions.

These fresh observations vary history at matched u and h, while other fresh rows vary h at matched u and history. Grouping lag and history together tests whether their combined contribution is incompatible with additive separation from current drive.

remaining_uncertainties: The reported C5 and C6 dev RMSE values alone do not establish failure of any broader additive-separation class; exact partition RMSEs remain to be computed.
Partition tests can establish empirical adequacy on supplied rows, not a unique mechanism or generalization beyond them.

language.types: Vector arithmetic broadcasts scalars. sum/mean reduce. Parameters use names, never p[i]. Dimension is [time exponent,response exponent]. Output must have dimension [0,1].
language.construction: At complete-model submission, declare ALL parameters, sequential quantities, exposed inputs, and equation together. The earlier operation selection freezes no coefficients or quantity definitions. Full rewriting and no-new-quantity solutions remain available.
language.limits: At most 8 parameters and 8 quantities. Finite lower < initial < upper. Expressions <=1600 characters and 300 nodes. No observed response, row ids, per-row constants, slicing, comprehensions or arbitrary code.
language.experiment_interface: Up to four novel conditions: u [-1.1,1.1], h [0,2.5], history length four with values [-1,1]. Fixed times [-4,-3,-2,-1] and dt=1. Four repeats each. Only drives/waiting/response available; no internal-state sensor.

scientific_goal: Define useful quantities or relationships and a complete response that explains the observed failure. Ground changes in evidence and propose informative executable new conditions. Prediction validity is distinct from unique mechanism identification.

chosen_partial_operation.reason: Select joint because all proposed partitions are invalid, and the failed additive models do not establish failure of a broader additive-separation class. The supplied contrasts show response differences across histories at matched current conditions and across waiting times, so retain the ability to model interactions across inputs. This choice does not identify a unique mechanism.

instruction: Submit one complete executable replacement. Declare all named shared parameters and their dimensions, all quantities, exposed raw inputs, and the required equation fields together. Final raw response dimension is [0,1]. Every symbol must be declared. evidence_refs must be actual row_ids. Propose up to four NEW conditions different from all supplied fit/dev rows; only drive, waiting time and response are available. Do not merely rename missing measurements.
completion_semantics: For joint use expression. For separate use left_expression and right_expression; tool checks their raw dependencies and adds them. Definitions may be shared but may not bypass branch dependencies.
